name: Decomposing Predictive Kubernetes Autoscaling for Large Language Model Serving Under Long Startup Delays (arXiv 2609.20874)
publisher: arXiv (Huazhong University of Science and Technology)
notes: arXiv comment 'accepted by CloudCom 2026' — this is the arXiv comment field's ONLY venue evidence for this record, and I could not independently confirm it against a CloudCom proceedings page, so per the repo rule the venue is recorded as arxiv-preprint and the claim is flagged here. CloudCom is not in the schema venue enum anyway. Decomposes predictive autoscaling into four factors and measures each in isolation on ServeGen workloads.
